test_title: PYST 6: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A stationery supplier ordered 10 boxes of premium pens and some boxes of standard pens. The price of premium pens per box was twice that of standard pens. When the order was delivered, the number of boxes of premium and standard pens had been accidentally interchanged. This increased the total bill by 25%. What was the ratio...?
solution:
**Given:**

Premium boxes ordered = 10

Standard boxes ordered = x

Price per premium box = 2 × price per standard box

After interchange (10 premium ↔ 10 standard, x standard ↔ x premium) total bill increases by 25%

Calculations:

Original bill = 10P + xS

New bill = 10S + xP

P = 2S, New = 1.25 × Original

Original = (10 × 2S) + xS = (20 + x)S

New = (10S) + x × 2S = (10 + 2x)S

⇒ (10 + 2x)S = 1.25 × (20 + x)S

⇒ 10 + 2x = 1.25(20 + x)

⇒ 10 + 2x = 25 + 1.25x

⇒ 2x − 1.25x = 25 − 10

⇒ 0.75x = 15

⇒ x = 15 ÷ 0.75 = 20

**∴ Ratio (premium : standard) = 10 : 20 = 1 : 2.**
